purpose: A new payment service that replaces the monolith payment module, providing the same 5 endpoints for merchants with no contract changes and sending status events to Kafka for ledger and notifications.

components.name: Edge GW
components.evidence: Edge GW (a.k.a. PEG): entrance for merchant calls

components.name: payments-core
components.evidence: payments-core: state machine, talks to acquirer connector (acq-conn)

components.name: payments-db
components.evidence: payments-db (PostgreSQL): payment + refund records of the merchants.
